Actions.Name: Server metric
Actions.Tooltip: CPU, RAM, swap, load, disk, network, temperature or GPU of a server running Glances

Author: darkanum
Name: Glances Monitor
Description: Live server metrics from the Glances REST API on your keys.
Detail: Each key shows one live metric of a server that runs Glances: CPU, memory, swap, load, disk, network, temperature, GPU usage or GPU temperature. Works with Glances 4 (API v4) and Glances 3 (API v3), and with password login on Glances 4. Disk, network, temperature and GPU keys can follow a specific partition, interface, sensor or GPU. Keys turn green, amber or red at limits you set, and show a clear state when the server is offline, the login fails or there is no data. Source and setup guide: https://github.com/darkanum/ulanzi-glances-monitor
